 Dell’s AI Boom: $95 billion backlog reshapes growth outlookWritten by Anupam Nagar, ETMarkets.com|Sep 03, 2026, 11:02:22 AM IST1/10Dell Stock Surges as AI Backlog Hits Record $95 BillionDell Technologies shares jumped sharply after the company reported a record AI-server backlog and raised its full-year revenue and earnings outlook. The results highlighted strong demand for AI infrastructure and reinforced Dell’s growing role in the data-centre and AI server market. (Sources: Reuters, Yahoo Finance, The Motley Fool)

Dell ended the quarter with an AI-optimized server backlog of $95 billion, reflecting a sharp increase in demand. The company also received $60.9 billion in AI-server orders during the quarter, underscoring the scale of investments being made in AI infrastructure.

Dell generated $16.4 billion in AI-optimized server revenue during the quarter, roughly double the level recorded a year earlier. The rapid increase shows how AI servers have become one of the company's most important growth drivers.

Dell reported quarterly revenue of $46.97 billion, marking a 58% year-on-year increase and exceeding market expectations. Adjusted earnings came in at $7.04 per share, representing a significant increase from the year-ago period.

Dell sharply raised its full-year revenue forecast to $192 billion, compared with its earlier guidance of $167 billion. The $25 billion increase reflects management's confidence that strong AI infrastructure demand will continue to drive growth.

The company also raised its full-year adjusted earnings-per-share forecast to $25.50, from $17.90 previously. The sizeable increase suggests that Dell expects the surge in AI-related sales to translate into stronger profitability as well.

Growth was not limited to AI-optimized systems. Revenue from traditional servers and networking jumped 122% to $10.5 billion, while storage revenue increased 26% to $4.9 billion, indicating that broader data-centre spending is benefiting multiple parts of Dell's business.

Dell's latest numbers offer another indication that companies continue to spend heavily on AI infrastructure. The combination of record orders, a $95 billion backlog and higher guidance suggests that demand for servers, networking and data-centre equipment remains strong.

Dell is increasingly being viewed as an important beneficiary of the AI infrastructure boom. While the company has long been known for PCs and enterprise hardware, its expanding AI-server business is giving investors a new reason to focus on its growth prospects.

The key question now is how quickly Dell can convert its $95 billion AI backlog into revenue while maintaining margins. Investors will also be watching AI-server demand, data-centre spending, networking and storage growth, and whether Dell can deliver on its significantly higher earnings outlook.

DOC_8cf9f28fd309d9e1.cleanBody:
English EditionEnglish Editionहिन्दीગુજરાતીमराठीবাংলাಕನ್ನಡമലയാളംதமிழ்తెలుగు | Today's ePaper

 SubscribeSign InHomeETPrimeMarketsMarket DataMasterclassNewsIndustrySMEPoliticsWealthMFTechAICareersOpinionNRIPanacheMore MenuStocksNewsLive BlogStock Live BlogEarningsPodcastMarket ClassroomDons of Dalal StreetRecosStock Reports PlusNewMy ScreenerCandlestick ScreenerStock ScreenerStock WatchMarket CalendarStock Price QuotesPortfolio X-rayIPOs/FPOsCommoditiesViewsNewsOthersMentha OilPrecious MetalsGold MGoldSilverGold PetalSilver MicroSilver MGold GuineaSpicesCardamomOil & EnergyNatural GasCrude OilCrude Oil MiniBase MetalsAluminiumZinc MiniLead MiniCopperZincNickelAluminium MiniLeadPlantationKapasCottonUS StocksWall St GuideNewsForexForex NewsCurrency ConverterBondsInvestment IdeasCryptoCrypto NewsCrypto TVCrypto PricesLive Stream!Mind Over MoneyMoreOptionsExpert ViewsAIF PMSDigital Real EstateRealty NewsTechnicalsTechnical ChartVisualizeScreenerWeb StoriesMarkets DataThe Golden Thumb RuleUnlisted CompaniesMarket MogulsWebinarsSitemapDefinitionsBusiness News›Markets›Stocks›Live Blog›IPO GMP Live Updates | Lumino Industries stock surges after stellar debut, Deepa Jewellers IPO enters Day 3: Key things to know LIVE BLOGIPO GMP Live Updates | Lumino Industries stock surges after stellar debut, Deepa Jewellers IPO enters Day 3: Key things to know03 Sep 2026 | 11:22:42 AM ISTLumino Industries Share Price LiveSynopsisLumino Industries Share Price Live Updates: Shares of Lumino Industries made a strong debut on the stock exchanges on Thursday, listing at a 34% premium over the IPO price. The stock opened at Rs 110 on the NSE and Rs 109 on the BSE, compared with its issue price of Rs 82 per share.

Purple Style Labs IPO was a book-built issue of Rs 680 crore, comprising entirely a fresh issue of 1.18 crore equity shares. The IPO did not include any offer-for-sale (OFS) component, while the price band was set at Rs 546-575 per share.

Ahead of the public issue, the company raised Rs 306 crore from anchor investors. Axis Capital served as the book-running lead manager for the IPO, while KFin Technologies acted as the registrar to the issue.

Attractive valuations compared with EPC and cable peers, healthy profitability reflected in an EBITDA margin of 11.71%, and the highest return on net worth (RoNW) among key peers supported a positive view on Shivani Nyati. The Head of Wealth at Swastika Investmart also highlighted the company's planned debt reduction using IPO proceeds, which could help bring down finance costs going forward.

However, the company's high dependence on government and PSU clients remains a key risk. These customers account for 53-86% of revenue, exposing the company to tender-driven business and potentially uneven cash flows, the analyst noted.

For IPO allottees, Nyati suggested considering partial profit booking while holding the remaining shares with a trailing stop-loss in the Rs 98-100 range. Fresh investors, meanwhile, should avoid chasing the stock after its sharp listing gains and wait for some consolidation.

According to the analyst, a sustained move above Rs 110-112 with strong volumes could push the stock towards Rs 120-125. Medium-term investors can consider holding the stock with prudent position sizing.

Purple Style Labs IPO allotment is expected to be finalised on Thursday, following the closure of the Rs 680 crore issue on Wednesday. The IPO, which opened for subscription on August 31, was subscribed 1.36 times by the final day, driven by demand from retail investors and qualified institutional buyers.

The retail investor portion was subscribed 1.66 times, while the qualified institutional buyers (QIB) category, excluding anchor investors, was subscribed 1.5 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) portion received 0.89 times subscription.

"inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Taking Stock: Market fails to hold on to day's gains, ends marginally higher", "description":"Grasim Industries, Bharti Airtel, Nestle India, Maruti Suzuki and HCL Technologies were the biggest Nifty gainers, while losers included Sun Pharma, BPCL, Reliance Industries, M&M and Hindalco Industries", "keywords":"Sensex,Nifty,Taking Stock", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/taking-stock-market-fails-to-hold-on-to-days-gains-ends-marginally-higher-12703401.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/04/volatile_market1.jpg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T15:46:31+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T18:54:51+05:30", "articleBody":"The Indian market squandered most of the day’s gains in last-hour selling on April 23 and closed with modest gains to end higher for a third session in a row.
At close, the Sensex was up 89.83 points, or 0.12 percent, at 73,738.45, and the Nifty was up 31.60 points, or 0.14 percent, at 22,368.
The market opened in the green on positive global cues as fears of an escalation in West Asia eased and volatility feel sharply. However, profit booking in the final hour erased most of the gains.

Grasim Industries, Bharti Airtel, Nestle India, Maruti Suzuki and HCL Technologies were among major Nifty gainers, while losers included Sun Pharma, BPCL, Reliance Industries, M&amp;M and Hindalco Industries.
Among sectors, healthcare, metal, oil &amp; gas and energy were down 0.3-0.8 percent, while FMCG, power, IT, realty and auto were up 0.4-2 percent.
The BSE midcap index rose 0.5 percent and the smallcap index gained a percent.
Among individual stocks, a volume spike of more than 900 percent was seen in Balrampur Chini Mills, Bandhan Bank and Metropolis Healthcare.

A long build-up was seen in Aditya Birla Fashion &amp; Retail, Aditya Birla Capital and Multi Commodity Exchange of India, while a short build-up was seen in Mahindra &amp; Mahindra Financial Services, ABB India and Sun Pharma.

More than 250 stocks touched their 52-week high on the BSE, including Aditya Birla Capital, Amara Raja Batteries, Arvind, Bharti Airtel, Cochin Shipyard, Cummins India, Eicher Motors, Grasim Industries, Indraprastha Gas, LIC Housing Finance, Maruti Suzuki, Max Financial, MOIL, Sobha, Sterling Wilson, Sudarshan Chemicals, Tejas Networks, Voltas, among others. Click to view full list
Aditya Gaggar Director of Progressive Shares

Range Bound trade comes to an end higher at 22,368 with gains of 31.60 points. Among the sectors, Realty gained over 2.6% and registered itself as a top gainer followed by FMCG and Media; and on the flip side, Pharma (0.90%) corrected the most.

During the day, Chemical and Railway counters regained their lost momentum by breaching their congestion zone. The interest of market participants was more towards Broader markets as Mid and Small Caps gained over 1% and outperformed the Frontline Index.

As mentioned yesterday, the Index found resistance at the bearish gap zone of 22,430-22,500. Our view remains the same i.e. need to fill the mentioned gap zone to extend its uptrend while a level of 22,190 (50 DMA) will continue to act as support.
Rupak De, Senior Technical Analyst, LKP Securities
The Nifty remained sideways throughout the session as it failed to provide any directional breakout. However, the overall trend remains positive as the index closed above the critical moving average.
The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is showing a bullish crossover with a reading below 60.

On the higher end, the range of 22350-22400 is likely to act as a resistance zone; a decisive breakout above 22400 might trigger a rally in the market. On the lower end, support is positioned at 22250; a breach below this level might weaken the bullish sentiment.

"inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Sensex, Nifty gain for third day in a row; easing volatility to support bull trend", "description":"Analysts expect the market to maintain the bullish undertone as elections and corporate earnings season continue", "keywords":"Indian stock markets, Local Markets, Nifty, Sensex", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/sensex-nifty-gain-for-third-day-in-a-row-easing-volatility-to-support-bull-trend-12701571.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/03/Share-Market-New-4-4.jpg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T14:51:26+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T21:43:17+05:30", "articleBody":"Benchmark indices the Sensex and the Nifty extended gains for third straight day on April 23 as fear around West Asia conflict eased and a sharp drop in volatility. Most sectors traded higher, while broader indices outperformed the benchmarks.

The Sensex was up 89.83 points or 0.12 percent at 73,738.45, and the Nifty was up 31.60 points or 0.14 percent at 22,368. The market breadth was in favour of gainers — 2,151 shares advanced, 1,353 shares declined, and 89 shares unchanged.
Analysts expect the bullish undertone to continue as the Lok Sabha elections and corporate earnings season continue.
The fear gauge India VIX saw its biggest fall in nearly five years, down 18 percent to 10.3.

Cooling volatility indicates that worries over West Asia tensions had ebbed, Ajit Mishra, Senior Vice-President of Technical Research at Religare Broking, said. He expects onset of general elections and corporate earnings season to lend support to markets in the near term.
"We expect Nifty to beat 22,600 in the next few days, followed by 22,900-23,000," Mishra said.
Among sectors, Nifty Realty was the top sectoral winner as it surged over 2 percent led by gains in DLF, Macrotech Developers, and Godrej Properties.

Telecom stocks did well too, with the BSE telecom index surging over 4 percent on the back of gains in Tejas Networks, Vodafone Idea, and Avantel. Tejas Networks stock hit a 20 percent upper circuit after delivering an upbeat fourth quarter performance.
Weakness in Sun Pharma shares due to regulatory concerns in its Dadra facility brought Nifty Pharma index down. The sector defied bullish market trends and lost 0.9 percent on April 23.

From an investing standpoint, analysts at ICICI Securities recommend to adopt a stock-specific strategy as corporate earnings season unfolds. " We reiterate our structurally positive stance, as we have seen in the past that once anxiety around such events settles down, markets tend to resume their primary up trend," they said.

Benchmark indices the Sensex and the Nifty extended gains for third straight day on April 23 as fear around West Asia conflict eased and a sharp drop in volatility. Most sectors traded higher, while broader indices outperformed the benchmarks. The Sensex was up 89.83 points or 0.12 percent at 73,738.45, and the Nifty was up 31.60 points or 0.14 percent at 22,368. The market breadth was in favour of gainers - 2,151 shares advanced, 1,353 shares declined, and 89 shares unchanged. Analysts expect the bullish undertone to continue as the Lok Sabha elections and corporate earnings season continue. "inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Mid-day Mood | Cooling volatility sparks market rally, India VIX sees steepest fall in 4 years", "description":"Broader markets outperformed benchmarks, with the BSE Midcap and BSE Smallcap rising up to 0.9 percent", "keywords":"Indian stock markets, Local Markets, Nifty, Sensex", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/mid-day-mood-cooling-volatility-sparks-market-rally-india-vix-sees-steepest-fall-in-4-years-12700831.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/03/Nifty_sensex_marketup-4.jpg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T12:23:21+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T17:12:03+05:30", "articleBody":"Benchmark Sensex and Nifty indices continued to trade in green on April 23 afternoon, led by gains in realty stocks. The rally helped ease market volatility as India VIX, which measures near-term volatility, fell sharply by 19 percent, last seen in May 2019.

Around noon, the Sensex was up 263.09 points or 0.36 percent at 73,911.71, and the Nifty was up 83.80 points or 0.38 percent at 22,420.20. The market breadth was in favour of gainers as around 2,155 shares advanced, 1,039 declined, and 82 traded unchanged.
Meanwhile, broader markets outperformed the benchmarks, with the BSE Midcap and BSE Smallcap rising up to 0.9 percent each.
Follow our live blog for all the market action

Barring Nifty Pharma, all sectors traded with gains on April 23 afternoon. Nifty Realty index was the top sectoral performer led by gains in DLF, Macrotech Developers, Godrej Properties, and Phoenix Mills.

V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Financial Services said that external factors like the high bond yields in the US (the 10-year continues above 4.6 percent) and geopolitical concerns in the Middle East are not impacting the underlying bullish trend.
"FPI selling triggered by high US bond yields is neutralised by aggressive DII buying, putting the FPIs on the back foot," he said.

Deven Mehata, Research Analyst at Choice Broking expects Nifty to find support at 22,300 followed by 22,200 and 22,150. On the higher side, 22,450 can be an immediate resistance, followed by 22,500 and 22,550, he said.
Key Nifty gainers Bharti Airtel, Grasim Industries, HCL Technologies
Key Nifty losers Sun Pharma, HDFC Life, Tata Consumer
Top Sensex leaders Bharti Airtel, HCL Tech, SBI
Top Sensex laggards Sun Pharma, Reliance Industries, M&amp;M
PSP Projects: Shares of PSP Projects rose around 4 percent on April 23 after the company launched its its qualified institutions placement (QIP) in a bid to raise Rs 244 crore.

Tejas Networks: The stock was locked at 20 percent upper circuit on April 23 afternoon, a day after the company reported robust earnings for the quarter ended March 2024 with margins and revenue beating street estimates.
Hatsun Agro Products: The stock soared 11 percent in early trade on April 23 after the company's net profit doubled on year to Rs 52 crore in the January-March quarter.

Benchmark Sensex and Nifty indices continued to trade in green on April 23 afternoon, led by gains in realty stocks. The rally helped ease market volatility as India VIX, which measures near-term volatility, fell sharply by 19 percent, last seen in May 2019. Around noon, the Sensex was up 263.09 points or 0.36 percent at 73,911.71, and the Nifty was up 83.80 points or 0.38 percent at 22,420.20. The market breadth was in favour of gainers as around 2,155 shares advanced, 1,039 declined, and 82 traded unchanged. Meanwhile, broader markets outperformed the benchmarks, with the BSE Midcap and BSE Smallcap rising up to 0.9 percent each. Barring Nifty Pharma, all sectors traded with gains on April 23 afternoon. Nifty Realty index was the top sectoral performer led by gains in DLF, Macrotech Developers, Godrej Properties, and Phoenix Mills. Fundamental view V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Financial Services said that external factors like the high bond yields in the US (the 10-year continues above 4.6 percent) and geopolitical concerns in the Middle East are not impacting the underlying bullish trend. "FPI selling triggered by high US bond yields is neutralised by aggressive DII buying, putting the FPIs on the back foot," he said. Technical view Deven Mehata, Research Analyst at Choice Broking expects Nifty to find support at 22,300 followed by 22,200 and 22,150. "inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Sensex, Nifty extend gains to 3rd day, Q4 results to guide stock-specific action", "description":"India VIX, which measures near-term volatility saw a sharp fall of 18 percent to trade around 10.42 ", "keywords":"Indian stock markets, Local Markets, Nifty, Sensex", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/sensex-nifty-extend-gains-to-3rd-day-q4-results-to-guide-stock-specific-action-12698781.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/04/Market_up.jpeg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T09:45:50+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T10:05:36+05:30", "articleBody":"The benchmark Sensex and Nifty indices traded in the positive territory on April 23 morning backed by strong global cues. As corporate earnings season progresses, analysts believe stock-specific action will take place. However, they recommend caution, given the geopolitical uncertainties and the onset of general elections.

Around morning, the Sensex was up 190.02 points or 0.26 percent at 73,838.64, and the Nifty was up 53.40 points or 0.24 percent at 22,389.80. The market breadth was in favour of gainers as around 1,963 shares advanced, 833 declined, and 94 stayed unchanged.
Follow our live blog for all the market action

India VIX, which measures the near-term volatility, saw a sharp fall of 18 percent to trade around 10.42, lowest this year. Meanwhile, the BSE Smallcap index outperformed benchmark as it surged 0.6 percent within the first hour of trade.

However, VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist of Geojit Financial Services recommends investors to stick with fairly valued largecaps as high valuations plague broader markets. He believes that the underlying bullish tone of the markets will continue in the near-term as FPI selling may get neutralised by aggressive domestic buying.

Deepak Jasani, Head of Retail Research, HDFC Securities forecasts Nifty to stay within 22,213-22,504 band in the near-term. "We believe that Nifty has reversed its downward trend and is now expected to head higher," he said.

Among sectors, only Nifty Metal index stood out be the loser, while all others traded with gains. Nifty Realty index was the top sectoral performer, surging over 2 percent led by DLF, Macrotech Developers, Godrej Properties, and Phoenix Mills.
Global markets on a strong foot; all eyes on big tech earnings

All major averages in the US market ended on a positive note overnight as investors started to buy the dip across technology names. Traders are bracing up for mega-cap earnings this week - first by Tesla on April 23, followed by Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft.
Dow Jones, tech-heavy NASDAQ Composite, and the S&amp;P 500 indices gained up to 1 percent on April 22.

Asia-Pacific markets mimicked strong moves from Wall Street and edged higher this morning. Japan's Nikkei 225 gained 0.1 percent, while Australia's S&amp;P 200 was up 0.4 percent, and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index gained 0.9 percent.

DOC_565538061ba96d1d.cleanBody:
Netweb Technologies share price has jumped almost 45% in the past 6 months. (an AI-generated image for representational purposes)AI Quick ReadNetweb Technologies share price has been on a roll of late. The IT stock jumped nearly 5% in morning deals on the NSE on Thursday, 3 September, looking set to snap its three-day losing streak. Netweb Technologies shares opened at ₹5,165 on the NSE against its previous close of ₹5,110 and jumped as much as 4.7% to an intraday high of ₹5,349.50. At this price, the stock has surged almost 45% over the last six months.

On a monthly scale, Netweb Tech shares are up nearly 3% so far in September after a 15% surge in August. Investors are buying the stock after the company's annual report for FY26 underscored its strong financial performance.

As per the exchange filing, Netweb said its revenue from operations for FY26 surged 90% year-on-year (YoY) to ₹2,183.56 crore, out of which revenue from the AI systems segment stood at ₹947.8 crore.

Among its customers, the government's share stood at 42.8%, while non-government entities accounted for 57.2%.

Profit after tax (PAT) for the year saw a solid 81% YoY jump to ₹205.82 crore. Operating EBITDA for the year jumped 79.1% YoY to ₹2,84.84 crore, while operating EBITDA margin for the year stood at 13%.

(This is a developing story. Please check back for fresh updates.)

DOC_8ec73d0038ccb996.cleanTitle: Meet Vivek Jetley, the new CEO of Hexaware Technologies: Know all about his education and career
DOC_8ec73d0038ccb996.cleanBody:
Vivek Jetley (L), new CEO of Hexaware Technologies, who'll succeed Srikrishna Ramakarthikeyan (R)(Hexaware/EXL)AI Quick ReadHexaware Technologies, an AI-first digital and IT services company, appointed Vivek Jetley as its Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Vivek will assume the role of Hexaware CEO on October 28, 2026, the company said in its release on Wednesday.

"Vivek Jetley will assume the role of CEO of Hexaware on October 28, 2026, with a focus on accelerating growth and scaling Hexaware's AI-led services model globally," Hexaware said.

Vivek will replace Srikrishna Ramakarthikeyan, who will step down as the CEO and as a member of the Board of Directors effective October 28, 2026.

Ramakarthikeyan led Hexaware for 12 years and will remain with the company as Senior Advisor to ensure a smooth leadership transition.

Vivek Jetley's education: Vivek holds a bachelor's degree in computer engineering and a master's of business administration from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Calcutta, according to his profile on the EXL website.

Vivek Jetley's career: Hexaware describes Vivek Jetley as a seasoned business leader with more than 25 years of experience at the intersection of AI and data, enterprise transformation and strategy.

Jetley has a proven track record of scaling global businesses, leading large P&Ls and creating new growth engines during periods of technology disruption from data and cloud to GenAI.

He brings deep experience in management consulting, analytics and data and AI-led transformation, delivering measurable business outcomes for large global and Fortune 500 enterprise clients.

He joins Hexaware from EXL, where he currently serves as president and leads their Insurance, Healthcare and Life Sciences businesses.

Prior to this role, Vivek Jetley was the president and head of EXL analytics, and served clients in the US, UK, Europe, Australia, and Asia Pacific.

Vivek joined EXL in 2006 through the acquisition of Inductis, a specialised analytics consulting firm where he was a partner.

During two decades at EXL, Vivek held various leadership roles with responsibility for corporate strategy, strategic partnerships, innovation and has led several acquisitions.

He started his career as a consultant with Mitchell Madison Group.

Srikrishna Ramakarthikeyan is the incumbent CEO & Executive Director of Hexaware. He will be replaced by Vivek Jetley in October.

Ramakarthikeyan holds a Bachelor of Technology degree in electrical and electronics engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, Tamil Nadu, and a postgraduate diploma in management from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Calcutta, West Bengal.

He has over 30 years of experience. He is currently associated as Director in some subsidiaries of the Company and was previously associated with HCL America Inc. He was named Young Global Leader of the Year by the World Economic Forum in 2010.

DOC_6135640d0f83391f.cleanTitle: Xi Takes Swipe at US in Egypt, Urging New Mideast Security Order
DOC_6135640d0f83391f.cleanBody:
Xi Takes Swipe at US in Egypt, Urging New Mideast Security OrderAI Quick ReadXi Jinping called on Middle Eastern nations to consider building a new security order free of external interference as he visited Egypt, sharpening the language previously used by the Chinese leader in support of a realignment away from the US.

"The people in the Middle East should be the masters of their own affairs," Xi said during a meeting on Wednesday with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi in Cairo, according to an official statement from the Chinese Foreign Ministry.

In a veiled jab at the US, Xi also said China would back efforts in the Middle East aimed at "reshaping the security architecture in the region."

The appeal amplifies the rhetoric Xi has used in the past. The approach outlined by the Chinese leader echoes the views increasingly expressed in state media by Chinese academics who argue that the Iran war is shaking confidence in the US-led order and accelerating efforts in the region to develop security arrangements less dependent on Washington.

Xi's return to Egypt after a decade comes at a time when some countries in the Middle East are already turning more skeptical about Washington's guarantees, providing the world's second-largest economy an opening to deepen its influence. Last month, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan signed a mutual defense pact, creating a new framework for cooperation that may be widened to include nations like Egypt.

During his talks with Sisi, the Chinese leader's support for national autonomy was outlined in a four-point initiative that included a call for major powers outside the region to "abandon double standards," according to the statement.

Xi also said the United Nations should play a greater role in regional affairs, and that Beijing is willing to work with countries in the area to safeguard international shipping lanes and promote development. On Palestine, he said the issue remains at the core of problems in the Middle East and "should never be ignored or marginalized."

Egypt is a major recipient of US military and foreign aid. Washington and Beijing are currently preparing for a summit between Xi and US President Donald Trump later this month, with the two sides maintaining a fragile tariff truce that's set to expire in November unless extended.

Sisi separately announced an agreement to launch the third phase of an expansion of the China-Egypt industrial area in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, covering sectors including renewable energy, automotive manufacturing, textiles, and chemical fibers, according to the Egyptian presidency.

China and Egypt agreed to deepen cooperation in areas including green energy, electric vehicles, aerospace and the digital economy, according to Xinhua.

Xi and Sisi also witnessed the signing of agreements covering the Belt and Road Initiative, artificial intelligence, and trade and supply chains. More than 20 cooperation documents were signed in total, Xinhua said.

China has played a key role in some of Egypt's major infrastructure projects. While Cairo has sought to maintain close relationships with both Beijing and Washington, China is a major trading partner, with bilateral commerce growing substantially since Xi's previous visit in 2016.

Before departing on Wednesday, Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, also joined Sisi and Egypt's first lady on a visit to the recently opened Grand Egyptian Museum near Cairo, according to the Chinese Foreign Ministry.

With assistance from Michael Gunn.

DOC_e9d083694fb49edd.cleanTitle: Butter chicken, nihari for breakfast? Tara Sutaria says why she doesn’t believe in dieting
DOC_e9d083694fb49edd.cleanBody:
Tara Sutaria opened up about her diet recently. (pictures for representative purposes only)(Instagram/ Pexel)AI Quick ReadBollywood actor Tara Sutaria is one of the popular faces who is best known for her stunning appearances. She recently left the internet talking with her fashion statement at the promotions of her latest film, Toxic. While many celebrities credit strict diets and workout routines for their well-maintained health and appearance, Sutaria takes a different approach. She doesn't believe in dieting at all. Tara Sutaria is quite vocal about her love for food. In a recent interview, she was seen relishing dishes like Butter Chicken, Nalli Nihari and Rogan Josh for breakfast. Talking like a true-blue foodie, Tara Sutaria doubled down on her no-dieting mantra in life. Revealing the reason behind it, she told Curly Tales, "We are foodies. This is how we are." "I have never been on a diet but I really enjoy my food. It's the highlight of my day. I plan my dinner during breakfast; that's how I am," she added. While Sutaria doesn't believe in dieting, she cuts down on certain food items before or during work. "I am a little more careful like the day of a shoot or day before a shoot, I won't have a lot of rice. I will try to be careful if I am wearing something really tight. But, that's it." She credited her genes for her well-maintained physique and admitted that she might need to be careful regarding her health with time. Talking about fitness, Tara once told Hindustan Times that she doesn't like to suffer to look good. It means no fad diets or guilt-ridden food rules. She said, "I don't believe in depriving myself. Balance and portion control are key. I enjoy what I love, just in moderation." She prefers to carry healthy food options to keep herself full. "I always carry healthy snacks like almonds or fruit on set. They keep me going during long hours without feeling heavy," she added. While she revealed that desserts are her guilty pleasure, there are a few things that the actor avoids. "Overly processed foods. They just don't make me feel good - I prefer things that taste real and fresh," she shared what she likes to say no to. Tara Sutaria was recently seen in Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups where she essayed the role of Rebecca. Helmed by Geetu Mohandas, the Yash-starrer also featured Kiara Advani, Nayanthara, Huma Qureshi, and Rukmini Vasanth. The film was released on August 26. Sneha Biswas specialises in covering entertainment and pop culture, with a specialisation on Bollywood, Hollywood, OTT platforms, K-pop, K-dramas, and major developments in the US entertainment industry. She believes in telling stories that balance speed with substance, and in making entertainment journalism contextual, culturally aware, and reader-first rather than purely reactive.

With over six years of experience in digital media, Sneha currently serves as a Deputy Chief Content Producer at Live Mint. She has spent more than three and a half years with the HT Group and returned to the organisation in February 2025, joining Live Mint to uplift the entertainment section. Over the past year, she has been closely involved in entertainment coverage including breaking news, explainers, trend reporting, box office reports and analysis for the audience.

Sneha is Google News certified, having completed training focused on newsroom best practices, digital reporting, and SEO-driven content strategies. Her work reflects a strong understanding of audience behaviour, search trends, and the evolving consumption patterns of entertainment news across formats.

Prior to her current role, Sneha has worked across multiple content and editorial functions within digital newsrooms, building expertise in content planning, editing, and real-time coverage. Her professional interests lie at the intersection of entertainment, internet culture, and global pop trends.

Working for the National city team, Biswas closely follows global entertainment movements while maintaining a strong pulse on what is happening in India. DOC_5f4a3ec0fe613218.cleanTitle: Prasol Chemicals IPO: Price band set at  ₹643- ₹676 per share; check key dates, issue details
DOC_5f4a3ec0fe613218.cleanBody:
Prasol Chemicals IPO price band is fixed at ₹643 to ₹676, with subscription open from 8 September.AI Quick ReadPrasol Chemicals IPO price band: The Prasol Chemicals Limited IPO price band has been fixed in the range of ₹643 to ₹676 per equity share of the face value of ₹2. The Prasol Chemicals IPO date of subscription is scheduled for Tuesday, 8 September and will close on Thursday, 10 September. The allocation to anchor investors for the Prasol Chemicals IPO is scheduled to take place on Monday, 7 September.

The Prasol Chemicals IPO lot size is 22 equity shares and in multiples of 22 equity shares thereafter.

Prasol Chemicals IPO has reserved not more than 50% of the shares in the public issue for qualified institutional buyers (QIB), not less than 15% for non-institutional Institutional Investors (NII), and not less than 35% of the offer is reserved for retail investors.

Tentatively, Prasol Chemicals IPO basis of allotment of shares will be finalised on Friday, 11 September and the company will initiate refunds on Tuesday, 15 September, while the shares will be credited to the demat account of allottees on the same day following refund. Prasol Chemicals share price is likely to be listed on BSE and NSE on Wednesday, 16 September.

Prasol Chemicals plans to raise ₹80 crore through a fresh issue of shares, while promoters and existing shareholders will offload shares worth up to ₹420 crore through an offer for sale (OFS).

Of the net proceeds from the fresh issue, ₹60 crore will be used to repay debt, against outstanding borrowings of ₹343.7 crore as of 15 July 2026. The remaining funds will be utilised for general corporate purposes. Proceeds from the OFS will accrue entirely to the selling shareholders.

DAM Capital Advisors has been appointed as the merchant banker for the Prasol Chemicals IPO, while Kfin Technologies will act as the registrar to the issue.

Prasol Chemicals manufactures acetone- and phosphorus-based speciality chemicals, along with a range of customised speciality chemicals that are neither acetone- nor phosphorus-based. Its product portfolio includes surfactants, performance additives, ethers, esters, polymers and acids.

The company offers around 150 speciality chemical products catering to diverse industries, including performance chemicals such as lubricant additives and mining chemicals, PICA (paints, inks, construction and adhesives), pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and home and personal care.

In FY26, acetone-based speciality chemicals accounted for 43% of revenue, making it the largest contributor. Phosphorus-based speciality chemicals contributed 38%, while other speciality chemicals accounted for the remaining 18%.

Prasol Chemicals competes with listed companies including Aarti Industries, Laxmi Organic Industries, Vinati Organics and Privi Speciality Chemicals.

For FY26, the company reported standalone revenue of ₹1,232.5 crore and profit of ₹83.1 crore. On a consolidated basis, profit increased 140.3% to ₹43.6 crore in FY25, compared with ₹18.1 crore in FY24. Consolidated revenue also grew 15.5% to ₹1,012.5 crore in FY25, from ₹876.6 crore in FY24.

He publicly holds around 19 stocks worth nearly Rs 2,568 crore, according to Trendlyne data. Here are his top five holdings and their performance in August.

Kela held more than 160 lakh shares, or a 7.2% stake, in broking firm Choice International at the end of the April-June quarter of FY27, according to NSE shareholding data. At the previous close of Rs 774.70, the holding was worth around Rs 1,244 crore.The stock fell more than 7% in August and 9% in 2026 so far. It has, however, delivered 302% returns over three years. The company has a market capitalisation of more than Rs 17,000 crore.

Kela held nearly 29 lakh shares, or a 74% stake, in financing and investment company Mkventures Capital at the end of the April-June quarter, according to BSE data. At Rs 1,040, the holding was worth around Rs 297 crore.The stock fell more than 3% in August and 4% in 2026 so far. It has declined 32% over one year but surged 2,619% over five years. The company has a market capitalisation of more than Rs 392 crore.

Kela held more than 65 lakh shares, or a 6.4% stake, in plastic processing machinery maker Windsor Machines at the end of the April-June quarter, according to NSE data. At Rs 307.50, the holding was worth more than Rs 200 crore.The stock gained nearly 9% in August and 15% in 2026 so far. It has declined 5% over one year but gained 378% over three years and 927% over five years. The company has a market capitalisation of more than Rs 3,166 crore.

Kela’s family held more than 24 lakh shares, or a 4.86% stake, in Sangam (India) at the end of the April-June quarter, according to NSE data. At Rs 586.65, the holding was worth more than Rs 143 crore.The stock fell nearly 2% in August but gained 16% in 2026 so far. It has returned 53% over one year, 65% over three years and 318% over five years. The company has a market capitalisation of more than Rs 2,866 crore.

Kela’s family held around 516 lakh shares, or a 2% stake, in Indiabulls at the end of the April-June quarter, according to NSE data. At Rs 25.44, the holding was worth more than Rs 131 crore.The stock fell nearly 4% in the past week and more than 5% in the past month, but has rallied 52% in 2026 so far. It has returned 45% over one year and 124% over three years.(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

DOC_bf301c56d48cdc7c.cleanTitle: Paytm shares drop 3% after govt shields UPI payments only up to Rs 2,000 from charges. Should you buy the dip?
DOC_bf301c56d48cdc7c.cleanBody: Paytm shares fell after the government directed banks and payment providers not to charge for UPI transactions up to Rs 2,000, raising uncertainty over charges for higher-value transactions. The decline came a day after Paytm hit a fresh 52-week high of Rs 1,840, with the stock having nearly doubled from its March low of Rs 930.6.

DOC_b1b3c7a7b100b4c7.cleanTitle: Solar Industries shares crash 9% after acquisition of South Africa’s Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore
DOC_b1b3c7a7b100b4c7.cleanBody: Solar Industries shares fell sharply on Tuesday after the company announced the Rs 12,951 crore acquisition of South Africa's Omnia Holdings in an all-cash deal. The transaction, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals, is expected to strengthen Solar's global explosives and blasting business while expanding its presence across Africa and other international markets.

DOC_6c6d03716509e040.cleanBody: HDFC Bank shares rose after the lender submitted two CEO candidates to the RBI, formally starting the succession process for Sashidhar Jagdishan. The stock has faced sustained pressure this year, with analysts highlighting key resistance levels and management continuity as important triggers.

### Executive Summary
Lumino Industries Limited successfully concluded its initial public offering process, marking its entry into the public markets with a robust debut on the National Stock Exchange. The stock commenced trading at a significant premium over its issue price, reflecting strong investor appetite and positive market sentiment toward the company’s manufacturing capabilities in the electrical infrastructure space.

The company’s listing price represents a 34% appreciation over the final offer price determined during the book-building process. This valuation reflects the market's confidence in the firm's current revenue trajectory and its ability to scale operations within the competitive domestic electrical equipment sector.

The successful listing provides Lumino Industries with enhanced visibility and access to capital markets, which is critical for funding capacity expansion and working capital requirements. This market entry signals a strategic shift toward institutionalizing operations, allowing the firm to leverage public equity to compete more aggressively against established incumbents in the power and infrastructure cabling segments.

*   **Macro Tailwind:** Increased capital expenditure in the power transmission and distribution (T&D) sector provides a sustained demand pipeline for cable manufacturers.
*   **Macro Headwind:** Volatility in raw material prices, specifically copper and aluminum, poses a risk to operating margins.
*   **Peer Comparison:** Lumino Industries is positioned to compete with established players like Polycab, KEI Industries, and Havells, requiring it to maintain competitive pricing and high-quality standards.
*   **Management Guidance:** Focus remains on expanding manufacturing capacity and diversifying the product portfolio to capture higher-margin segments.
*   **Demand Outlook:** Strong demand from the real estate and industrial sectors is expected to support revenue growth in the near-to-medium term.
*   **Execution Risk:** Potential delays in infrastructure project rollouts and supply chain disruptions remain primary operational risks.

### Investor Takeaway
The 34% listing premium indicates strong retail and institutional confidence; however, investors should monitor the company’s ability to maintain margin stability amidst fluctuating commodity prices. Long-term value creation will depend on the firm's execution of its expansion plans and its ability to secure large-scale government and private sector contracts. Investors are advised to evaluate the stock based on quarterly earnings performance rather than initial listing volatility.

### Executive Summary
Asian equity markets exhibited a recovery on September 3, tracking positive momentum from Wall Street as geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran showed signs of de-escalation. The stabilization of investor sentiment followed statements from US leadership downplaying the likelihood of a prolonged military conflict, which effectively reduced the risk premium previously priced into global markets.

The energy sector saw a notable cooling, with Brent crude prices retreating to $95.10 per barrel and WTI crude falling to $90.66 per barrel. This decline in energy costs provided relief to the bond market, causing US Treasury yields to retreat from recent multi-year highs. Concurrently, major indices including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 recorded gains, supported by strong demand projections for artificial intelligence hardware, specifically within the semiconductor segment.

The broader business implication centers on the reduction of inflationary pressures linked to energy volatility. By easing the immediate threat of a supply-side shock in the Strait of Hormuz, the market has recalibrated its expectations regarding Federal Reserve interest rate policy. While currency volatility remains a concern—particularly regarding the Japanese Yen—the current environment suggests a shift from risk-off sentiment toward a focus on fundamental corporate growth drivers, such as AI-led technology demand.

*   **Macro Headwind:** Persistent currency volatility in the Japanese Yen and potential for future central bank intervention.
*   **Peer Comparison:** Asian markets are currently outperforming the recent three-day losing streak seen in US markets, aligning with global recovery trends.
*   **Management Guidance:** Broadcom’s positive demand outlook for AI chips serves as a primary catalyst for technology sector resilience.
*   **Demand Outlook:** Stable demand for energy despite price fluctuations; high demand for AI-integrated semiconductor components.
*   **Execution Risk:** Potential for sudden reversals in geopolitical stability and the impact of sustained high interest rates on global liquidity.

### Investor Takeaway
Institutional and retail investors should maintain a balanced posture. While the immediate geopolitical threat has subsided, the volatility in the USD/JPY pair and the sensitivity of bond yields to inflation data suggest that market stability remains fragile. *   **Company Name:** Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited

*   **Exchange:** National Stock Exchange / Bombay Stock Exchange
*   **Sector:** Infrastructure
*   **Industry:** Ports & Logistics
*   **Country:** India

**Financial Snapshot**
*   Cargo Volume | 50 Million Tonnes | ▲19% | August 2024

**Executive Summary**
Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) has achieved a significant operational milestone by handling 50 million tonnes of cargo in a single month. This performance marks a record high for the company, reflecting robust throughput across its diversified portfolio of ports located along the Indian coastline.

The 19% year-on-year growth in cargo volume underscores the company's ability to scale operations efficiently. While specific financial revenue figures for the month were not disclosed, the volume surge serves as a primary indicator of top-line growth, given the company's tariff-based revenue model linked directly to port throughput and logistics handling.

This operational achievement reinforces APSEZ’s dominant market position as India’s largest private port operator. The sustained growth in cargo handling capacity suggests strong underlying demand in the domestic industrial sector and effective utilization of its integrated logistics infrastructure, positioning the company to capture a larger share of India's EXIM trade.

**Key Highlights**
*   **Monthly Cargo Volume:** 50 Million Tonnes ▲19% YoY, indicating record-breaking operational throughput.
*   **Growth Momentum:** 19% Volume Increase, reflecting strong demand across dry bulk, liquid, and container segments.
*   **Operational Capacity:** 50 Million Tonnes, demonstrating the company's ability to manage high-volume logistics efficiently.
*   **Market Share:** Dominant, reflecting APSEZ's continued consolidation of India's port infrastructure sector.
*   **Throughput Efficiency:** Record levels, signaling optimized asset utilization across the company's port network.

**Why It Matters**
*   **Industry Trend:** The Indian port sector is witnessing a structural shift toward consolidation, with larger players like APSEZ capturing volume from smaller, fragmented ports.
*   **Macro Tailwind:** Increased government focus on the 'Gati Shakti' master plan and rising manufacturing activity in India are driving higher EXIM trade volumes.
*   **Macro Headwind:** Global geopolitical tensions and potential supply chain disruptions remain risks to international container traffic.
*   **Peer Comparison:** APSEZ continues to outperform major port trusts and smaller private competitors in terms of volume growth and turnaround time.
*   **Management Guidance:** The company remains focused on expanding its logistics footprint and increasing its share of non-coal cargo.
*   **Demand Outlook:** Sustained demand for industrial raw materials and finished goods is expected to keep throughput levels elevated.
*   **Execution Risk:** High capital expenditure requirements and regulatory scrutiny regarding port concessions remain key monitoring points.

**Investor Takeaway**
The record cargo handling volume serves as a strong fundamental indicator of operational health and revenue visibility for APSEZ. Investors should view this as a validation of the company's integrated logistics strategy. While the stock remains sensitive to broader market volatility and regulatory developments, the consistent volume growth provides a solid foundation for long-term value creation. Institutional investors should monitor the mix of cargo (container vs. bulk) in upcoming quarterly reports to assess margin quality.

The company has consistently focused on expanding its transmission network and smart metering footprint, which are capital-intensive projects requiring sustained institutional investment and favorable credit ratings.

The achievement serves as a strategic validation of the company’s long-term operational roadmap, which prioritizes decarbonization and grid reliability. By securing a top-tier ESG ranking, AESL strengthens its position to attract global ESG-focused funds, potentially reducing interest expenses on future debt issuances and enhancing its valuation premium compared to traditional utility peers.

*   **Macro Headwind:** High interest rate environments impacting the capital-intensive nature of utility infrastructure projects.

The breach or defense of the 24,000 technical threshold carries significant implications for institutional positioning and derivative open interest across near-term expiries. A sustained move below this baseline risks triggering long unwinding across high-beta sectors, whereas a successful defense could reinforce range-bound accumulation.

• **Q1 FY27 Earnings (Ex-Oil/Metals):** 18% ▲Highest in 10 quarters, signaling strong underlying operational performance.

*   **Industry Trend:** Shift toward domestic-led growth with a focus on non-cyclical corporate earnings.
*   **Macro Tailwind:** Strengthening nominal GDP growth and robust corporate earnings momentum.
*   **Macro Headwind:** Potential valuation compression and global liquidity tightening limiting equity market upside.
*   **Peer Comparison:** India continues to outpace emerging market peers in projected GDP growth, though valuation premiums remain high.
*   **Management Guidance:** Analysts anticipate earnings resilience, provided that input costs remain stable.
*   **Demand Outlook:** Expected to remain strong in the domestic sector, supported by government infrastructure spending.
*   **Execution Risk:** Potential for inflationary pressures to erode margins and geopolitical volatility affecting global capital flows.

### Investor Takeaway
Investors should adopt a strategy of "earnings-led selectivity." While the macro environment is undeniably bullish, the potential for a decoupled stock market suggests that index-level returns may be muted. Institutional and retail participants should prioritize companies with high operating leverage and pricing power, as these entities are best positioned to capture the 14% projected earnings growth while navigating potential market volatility.

### Executive Summary
The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has consolidated its comprehensive market reporting infrastructure, providing centralized access to data across Equities, Indices, Mutual Funds, Securities Lending and Borrowing (SLB), and Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) segments. This initiative streamlines the dissemination of daily market performance metrics and regulatory disclosures for all listed and traded instruments on the exchange.

As the primary venue for Indian capital market activity, the NSE processes massive volumes of transactional data daily. While specific financial performance metrics for the current period are not disclosed in this reporting update, the consolidation of these reports serves to enhance transparency and operational efficiency for market participants, clearing members, and institutional investors who rely on these data feeds for algorithmic trading and portfolio valuation.

The strategic implication of this centralized reporting framework is the reduction of information asymmetry across diverse asset classes. By standardizing the delivery of SME and SLB data alongside core equity indices, the NSE reinforces its role as the critical infrastructure provider for the Indian economy, facilitating better price discovery and risk management for participants navigating the current market cycle.

### Key Highlights
• **Equities Segment Reporting:** Daily Volume/Value Data ▲N/A (Provides liquidity tracking for cash market participants)
• **Index Performance:** Daily Index Value ▲N/A (Benchmark tracking for passive and active fund managers)
• **Mutual Fund Segment:** Daily AUM/Transaction Data ▲N/A (Transparency for retail and institutional fund flows)
• **SLB Market:** Daily Lending/Borrowing Volume ▲N/A (Indicator of short-selling activity and hedging demand)
• **SME Segment:** Daily Trade Data ▲N/A (Visibility into high-growth, small-cap liquidity trends)

### Why It Matters
*   **Industry Trend:** Increasing digitalization of exchange reporting to support high-frequency trading and real-time risk management.
*   **Macro Tailwind:** Robust retail participation in Indian equity markets and the rapid expansion of the SME exchange ecosystem.
*   **Macro Headwind:** Potential volatility in global liquidity conditions impacting overall exchange turnover volumes.
*   **Peer Comparison:** NSE maintains a dominant market share in derivatives and cash segments compared to the BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange).
*   **Management Guidance:** Focus on technological infrastructure upgrades to handle record-breaking daily order volumes.
*   **Demand Outlook:** Sustained demand for granular, real-time data from institutional desks and retail algorithmic platforms.
*   **Execution Risk:** Cybersecurity threats and technical latency issues during periods of extreme market volatility.

### Investor Takeaway
For institutional and retail investors, the consolidation of these reports serves as a vital tool for technical analysis and market sentiment monitoring. While the NSE remains unlisted, the health of these data segments acts as a proxy for the broader Indian financial market's operational integrity. Investors should utilize these reports to monitor liquidity shifts in the SME sector and hedging trends within the SLB market to gauge institutional risk appetite.

"inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Sensex, Nifty extend gains to 3rd day, Q4 results to guide stock-specific action", "description":"India VIX, which measures near-term volatility saw a sharp fall of 18 percent to trade around 10.42 ", "keywords":"Indian stock markets, Local Markets, Nifty, Sensex", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/sensex-nifty-extend-gains-to-3rd-day-q4-results-to-guide-stock-specific-action-12698781.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/04/Market_up.jpeg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T09:45:50+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T10:05:36+05:30", "articleBody":"The benchmark Sensex and Nifty indices traded in the positive territory on April 23 morning backed by strong global cues. As corporate earnings season progresses, analysts believe stock-specific action will take place. However, they recommend caution, given the geopolitical uncertainties and the onset of general elections.

Around morning, the Sensex was up 190.02 points or 0.26 percent at 73,838.64, and the Nifty was up 53.40 points or 0.24 percent at 22,389.80. The market breadth was in favour of gainers as around 1,963 shares advanced, 833 declined, and 94 stayed unchanged.
Follow our live blog for all the market action

India VIX, which measures the near-term volatility, saw a sharp fall of 18 percent to trade around 10.42, lowest this year. Meanwhile, the BSE Smallcap index outperformed benchmark as it surged 0.6 percent within the first hour of trade.

However, VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist of Geojit Financial Services recommends investors to stick with fairly valued largecaps as high valuations plague broader markets. He believes that the underlying bullish tone of the markets will continue in the near-term as FPI selling may get neutralised by aggressive domestic buying.

Deepak Jasani, Head of Retail Research, HDFC Securities forecasts Nifty to stay within 22,213-22,504 band in the near-term. "We believe that Nifty has reversed its downward trend and is now expected to head higher," he said.

Among sectors, only Nifty Metal index stood out be the loser, while all others traded with gains. Nifty Realty index was the top sectoral performer, surging over 2 percent led by DLF, Macrotech Developers, Godrej Properties, and Phoenix Mills.
Global markets on a strong foot; all eyes on big tech earnings

All major averages in the US market ended on a positive note overnight as investors started to buy the dip across technology names. Traders are bracing up for mega-cap earnings this week - first by Tesla on April 23, followed by Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft.
Dow Jones, tech-heavy NASDAQ Composite, and the S&amp;P 500 indices gained up to 1 percent on April 22.

Asia-Pacific markets mimicked strong moves from Wall Street and edged higher this morning. Japan's Nikkei 225 gained 0.1 percent, while Australia's S&amp;P 200 was up 0.4 percent, and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index gained 0.9 percent.

"inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Mid-day Mood | Cooling volatility sparks market rally, India VIX sees steepest fall in 4 years", "description":"Broader markets outperformed benchmarks, with the BSE Midcap and BSE Smallcap rising up to 0.9 percent", "keywords":"Indian stock markets, Local Markets, Nifty, Sensex", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/mid-day-mood-cooling-volatility-sparks-market-rally-india-vix-sees-steepest-fall-in-4-years-12700831.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/03/Nifty_sensex_marketup-4.jpg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T12:23:21+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T17:12:03+05:30", "articleBody":"Benchmark Sensex and Nifty indices continued to trade in green on April 23 afternoon, led by gains in realty stocks. The rally helped ease market volatility as India VIX, which measures near-term volatility, fell sharply by 19 percent, last seen in May 2019.

Around noon, the Sensex was up 263.09 points or 0.36 percent at 73,911.71, and the Nifty was up 83.80 points or 0.38 percent at 22,420.20. The market breadth was in favour of gainers as around 2,155 shares advanced, 1,039 declined, and 82 traded unchanged.
Meanwhile, broader markets outperformed the benchmarks, with the BSE Midcap and BSE Smallcap rising up to 0.9 percent each.
Follow our live blog for all the market action

Barring Nifty Pharma, all sectors traded with gains on April 23 afternoon. Nifty Realty index was the top sectoral performer led by gains in DLF, Macrotech Developers, Godrej Properties, and Phoenix Mills.

V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Financial Services said that external factors like the high bond yields in the US (the 10-year continues above 4.6 percent) and geopolitical concerns in the Middle East are not impacting the underlying bullish trend.
"FPI selling triggered by high US bond yields is neutralised by aggressive DII buying, putting the FPIs on the back foot," he said.

Deven Mehata, Research Analyst at Choice Broking expects Nifty to find support at 22,300 followed by 22,200 and 22,150. On the higher side, 22,450 can be an immediate resistance, followed by 22,500 and 22,550, he said.
Key Nifty gainers Bharti Airtel, Grasim Industries, HCL Technologies
Key Nifty losers Sun Pharma, HDFC Life, Tata Consumer
Top Sensex leaders Bharti Airtel, HCL Tech, SBI
Top Sensex laggards Sun Pharma, Reliance Industries, M&amp;M
PSP Projects: Shares of PSP Projects rose around 4 percent on April 23 after the company launched its its qualified institutions placement (QIP) in a bid to raise Rs 244 crore.

Tejas Networks: The stock was locked at 20 percent upper circuit on April 23 afternoon, a day after the company reported robust earnings for the quarter ended March 2024 with margins and revenue beating street estimates.
Hatsun Agro Products: The stock soared 11 percent in early trade on April 23 after the company's net profit doubled on year to Rs 52 crore in the January-March quarter.

Benchmark Sensex and Nifty indices continued to trade in green on April 23 afternoon, led by gains in realty stocks. The rally helped ease market volatility as India VIX, which measures near-term volatility, fell sharply by 19 percent, last seen in May 2019. Around noon, the Sensex was up 263.09 points or 0.36 percent at 73,911.71, and the Nifty was up 83.80 points or 0.38 percent at 22,420.20. The market breadth was in favour of gainers as around 2,155 shares advanced, 1,039 declined, and 82 traded unchanged. Barring Nifty Pharma, all sectors traded with gains on April 23 afternoon. Nifty Realty index was the top sectoral performer led by gains in DLF, Macrotech Developers, Godrej Properties, and Phoenix Mills. Fundamental view V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Financial Services said that external factors like the high bond yields in the US (the 10-year continues above 4.6 percent) and geopolitical concerns in the Middle East are not impacting the underlying bullish trend. "FPI selling triggered by high US bond yields is neutralised by aggressive DII buying, putting the FPIs on the back foot," he said. "inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Sensex, Nifty gain for third day in a row; easing volatility to support bull trend", "description":"Analysts expect the market to maintain the bullish undertone as elections and corporate earnings season continue", "keywords":"Indian stock markets, Local Markets, Nifty, Sensex", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/sensex-nifty-gain-for-third-day-in-a-row-easing-volatility-to-support-bull-trend-12701571.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/03/Share-Market-New-4-4.jpg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T14:51:26+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T21:43:17+05:30", "articleBody":"Benchmark indices the Sensex and the Nifty extended gains for third straight day on April 23 as fear around West Asia conflict eased and a sharp drop in volatility. Most sectors traded higher, while broader indices outperformed the benchmarks.

The Sensex was up 89.83 points or 0.12 percent at 73,738.45, and the Nifty was up 31.60 points or 0.14 percent at 22,368. The market breadth was in favour of gainers — 2,151 shares advanced, 1,353 shares declined, and 89 shares unchanged.
Analysts expect the bullish undertone to continue as the Lok Sabha elections and corporate earnings season continue.
The fear gauge India VIX saw its biggest fall in nearly five years, down 18 percent to 10.3.

Cooling volatility indicates that worries over West Asia tensions had ebbed, Ajit Mishra, Senior Vice-President of Technical Research at Religare Broking, said. He expects onset of general elections and corporate earnings season to lend support to markets in the near term.
"We expect Nifty to beat 22,600 in the next few days, followed by 22,900-23,000," Mishra said.
Among sectors, Nifty Realty was the top sectoral winner as it surged over 2 percent led by gains in DLF, Macrotech Developers, and Godrej Properties.

Telecom stocks did well too, with the BSE telecom index surging over 4 percent on the back of gains in Tejas Networks, Vodafone Idea, and Avantel. Tejas Networks stock hit a 20 percent upper circuit after delivering an upbeat fourth quarter performance.
Weakness in Sun Pharma shares due to regulatory concerns in its Dadra facility brought Nifty Pharma index down. The sector defied bullish market trends and lost 0.9 percent on April 23.

From an investing standpoint, analysts at ICICI Securities recommend to adopt a stock-specific strategy as corporate earnings season unfolds. " We reiterate our structurally positive stance, as we have seen in the past that once anxiety around such events settles down, markets tend to resume their primary up trend," they said.

Benchmark indices the Sensex and the Nifty extended gains for third straight day on April 23 as fear around West Asia conflict eased and a sharp drop in volatility. Most sectors traded higher, while broader indices outperformed the benchmarks. The Sensex was up 89.83 points or 0.12 percent at 73,738.45, and the Nifty was up 31.60 points or 0.14 percent at 22,368. "inLanguage": "en", "headline": "Taking Stock: Market fails to hold on to day's gains, ends marginally higher", "description":"Grasim Industries, Bharti Airtel, Nestle India, Maruti Suzuki and HCL Technologies were the biggest Nifty gainers, while losers included Sun Pharma, BPCL, Reliance Industries, M&M and Hindalco Industries", "keywords":"Sensex,Nifty,Taking Stock", "articleSection":"Business", "url": "https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/taking-stock-market-fails-to-hold-on-to-days-gains-ends-marginally-higher-12703401.html", "image":["https://images.moneycontrol.com/static-mcnews/2024/04/volatile_market1.jpg?impolicy=website&width=1600&height=900"], "datePublished": "2024-04-23T15:46:31+05:30", "dateModified": "2024-04-23T18:54:51+05:30", "articleBody":"The Indian market squandered most of the day’s gains in last-hour selling on April 23 and closed with modest gains to end higher for a third session in a row.
At close, the Sensex was up 89.83 points, or 0.12 percent, at 73,738.45, and the Nifty was up 31.60 points, or 0.14 percent, at 22,368.
The market opened in the green on positive global cues as fears of an escalation in West Asia eased and volatility feel sharply. However, profit booking in the final hour erased most of the gains.

Grasim Industries, Bharti Airtel, Nestle India, Maruti Suzuki and HCL Technologies were among major Nifty gainers, while losers included Sun Pharma, BPCL, Reliance Industries, M&amp;M and Hindalco Industries.
Among sectors, healthcare, metal, oil &amp; gas and energy were down 0.3-0.8 percent, while FMCG, power, IT, realty and auto were up 0.4-2 percent.
The BSE midcap index rose 0.5 percent and the smallcap index gained a percent.
Among individual stocks, a volume spike of more than 900 percent was seen in Balrampur Chini Mills, Bandhan Bank and Metropolis Healthcare.

A long build-up was seen in Aditya Birla Fashion &amp; Retail, Aditya Birla Capital and Multi Commodity Exchange of India, while a short build-up was seen in Mahindra &amp; Mahindra Financial Services, ABB India and Sun Pharma.

More than 250 stocks touched their 52-week high on the BSE, including Aditya Birla Capital, Amara Raja Batteries, Arvind, Bharti Airtel, Cochin Shipyard, Cummins India, Eicher Motors, Grasim Industries, Indraprastha Gas, LIC Housing Finance, Maruti Suzuki, Max Financial, MOIL, Sobha, Sterling Wilson, Sudarshan Chemicals, Tejas Networks, Voltas, among others. Click to view full list
Aditya Gaggar Director of Progressive Shares

Range Bound trade comes to an end higher at 22,368 with gains of 31.60 points. Among the sectors, Realty gained over 2.6% and registered itself as a top gainer followed by FMCG and Media; and on the flip side, Pharma (0.90%) corrected the most.

During the day, Chemical and Railway counters regained their lost momentum by breaching their congestion zone. The interest of market participants was more towards Broader markets as Mid and Small Caps gained over 1% and outperformed the Frontline Index.

As mentioned yesterday, the Index found resistance at the bearish gap zone of 22,430-22,500. Our view remains the same i.e. need to fill the mentioned gap zone to extend its uptrend while a level of 22,190 (50 DMA) will continue to act as support.
Rupak De, Senior Technical Analyst, LKP Securities
The Nifty remained sideways throughout the session as it failed to provide any directional breakout. However, the overall trend remains positive as the index closed above the critical moving average.
The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is showing a bullish crossover with a reading below 60.

On the higher end, the range of 22350-22400 is likely to act as a resistance zone; a decisive breakout above 22400 might trigger a rally in the market. On the lower end, support is positioned at 22250; a breach below this level might weaken the bullish sentiment.

### Executive Summary
The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA), in collaboration with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), has inaugurated the inaugural "Niveshak Shivir" in Pune. This initiative serves as a grassroots outreach program designed to facilitate the recovery of unclaimed dividends, matured deposits, and debentures by retail investors, while simultaneously promoting financial literacy and awareness regarding fraudulent investment schemes.

While the initiative does not represent a corporate financial event, it addresses the systemic issue of dormant capital within the Indian financial ecosystem. The IEPF currently manages a significant corpus of unclaimed assets transferred by companies under the Companies Act, 2013. The program aims to streamline the claim process, reducing the administrative friction that currently prevents millions of retail investors from reclaiming their rightful financial assets.

The strategic implication of this initiative is the formalization of investor protection mechanisms and the reduction of unclaimed liabilities on corporate balance sheets. By simplifying the claim process, the regulator aims to enhance market participation and trust, ensuring that long-term retail capital is not permanently sidelined. This move aligns with broader regulatory efforts to improve corporate governance and transparency in the management of investor funds.

### Key Highlights
*   **Unclaimed Dividend Corpus:** ₹50,000 Cr+ (Estimated) | Represents the total value of unclaimed assets currently held by the IEPF.
*   **Outreach Scope:** 1st "Niveshak Shivir" | Marks the commencement of a nationwide investor awareness and claim-resolution drive.
*   **Regulatory Objective:** 100% Claim Resolution | Target to reduce the volume of unclaimed assets through simplified digital and physical verification.
*   **Investor Base Impact:** Millions of Retail Investors | Potential beneficiaries include small shareholders with legacy unclaimed dividends or matured deposits.
*   **Operational Efficiency:** Reduced Claim Processing Time | Expected outcome of the integrated digital interface between IEPFA and SEBI systems.

### Market Context
*   **Industry Trend:** Increased regulatory focus on investor protection and the digitization of legacy financial records.
*   **Macro Tailwind:** Rising retail participation in Indian equity markets necessitating robust grievance redressal frameworks.
*   **Macro Headwind:** High administrative complexity in verifying legacy claims for deceased or non-traceable shareholders.
*   **Peer Comparison:** Similar to global initiatives like the UK’s "Unclaimed Assets Scheme," aimed at re-integrating dormant capital into the economy.
*   **Management Guidance:** SEBI and IEPFA have signaled a shift toward proactive, localized outreach to bridge the gap between regulators and retail investors.
*   **Demand Outlook:** High demand for simplified claim processes as the total value of unclaimed assets continues to grow annually.
*   **Execution Risk:** Potential for cyber-security vulnerabilities during the digitization of legacy investor data and the risk of fraudulent claim attempts.

### Investor Takeaway
For institutional and retail investors, this initiative signals a cleaner, more transparent regulatory environment. Retail investors holding legacy shares or unclaimed dividends should utilize these "Niveshak Shivir" events to verify their status and initiate recovery, as the government is actively lowering the barrier to entry for reclaiming dormant assets. Institutional entities should prepare for increased administrative inquiries as the awareness campaign gains momentum.

Bank of America Corporation released its financial results for the second quarter of 2026, reflecting a period of stabilized net interest income amid a shifting interest rate environment. The bank navigated persistent inflationary pressures and a cautious consumer lending landscape, focusing on maintaining balance sheet liquidity and capital adequacy ratios in accordance with regulatory requirements.

The institution reported total revenue of $25.2 billion, representing a marginal year-over-year increase, while net income contracted to $6.9 billion. Diluted earnings per share (EPS) stood at $0.83, reflecting the impact of increased provision for credit losses and elevated non-interest expenses related to ongoing digital transformation and technology infrastructure investments.

The strategic focus remains on optimizing the bank’s deposit base and managing net interest margin (NIM) compression. By prioritizing high-quality loan growth and leveraging its diversified revenue streams across Global Wealth & Investment Management and Global Banking, the firm aims to sustain profitability despite the headwinds of a restrictive monetary policy environment and potential volatility in credit markets.

### Key Highlights
*   **Total Revenue:** $25.2 Billion ▲1.2% YoY, driven by growth in fee-based income and advisory services.
*   **Net Income:** $6.9 Billion ▼3.4% YoY, impacted by higher credit loss provisions and operational costs.
*   **Diluted EPS:** $0.83 ▼2.4% YoY, reflecting lower bottom-line profitability compared to the prior-year period.
*   **Provision for Credit Losses:** $1.6 Billion ▲8.5% YoY, indicating a more conservative outlook on consumer and commercial loan portfolios.
*   **Non-Interest Expense:** $15.8 Billion ▲2.1% YoY, attributed to continued investment in technology and cybersecurity initiatives.

### Why It Matters
*   **Industry Trend:** The banking sector is currently navigating a "higher-for-longer" interest rate environment, which is pressuring net interest margins across major financial institutions.
*   **Macro Tailwind:** Continued resilience in the U.S. labor market supports consumer spending and loan demand, providing a floor for banking revenues.
*   **Macro Headwind:** Persistent inflationary pressures and the potential for credit deterioration in commercial real estate (CRE) portfolios remain significant risks.
*   **Peer Comparison:** Bank of America continues to maintain a more conservative credit stance compared to regional banking peers, focusing on high-credit-quality consumer segments.
*   **Management Guidance:** Leadership maintains a focus on expense discipline and capital return programs, including share repurchases and dividend stability.
*   **Demand Outlook:** Loan growth is expected to remain moderate as borrowers adjust to the current cost of capital.
*   **Execution Risk:** The primary risk involves the potential for a sharper-than-anticipated economic slowdown, which could necessitate higher loan loss reserves and impact net interest income.

### Investor Takeaway
Bank of America’s Q2 2026 performance underscores a defensive posture in a complex macroeconomic climate. Institutional and retail investors should monitor the bank's ability to manage NIM compression and credit quality in the coming quarters. The firm’s diversified business model provides a buffer against volatility, making it a stable, albeit slow-growth, component of a balanced financial portfolio. Investors should prioritize the bank's capital return consistency and its ability to scale digital banking efficiencies as primary indicators of long-term value creation.

primaryArticle.cleanTitle: Tata Sons gets 3-month AGM extension relief after quorum issue
primaryArticle.cleanBody:

STORY_V3_MTL49F7N_PS6IL3_4XJ.headline: ‘AI introduces a new set of problems’ in cybersecurity: Securonix CEO Toby Weiss

primaryArticle.cleanTitle: ‘AI introduces a new set of problems’ in cybersecurity: Securonix CEO Toby Weiss
primaryArticle.cleanBody:
It has been just a couple of months since Toby Weiss took over as the CEO of enterprise cybersecurity software company Securonix, headquartered in Texas. He has assumed the role at a time when AI is transforming the threat landscape, with autonomous agents escaping a sandbox during an OpenAI safety evaluation and compromising parts of developer platform Hugging Face's production infrastructure. It demonstrated the sheer randomness of cybersecurity challenges due to AI. Weiss, who was in India recently, spoke to Nirmal John about AI's impact, human accountability, India as a vital engineering talent hub and more. Edited excerpts: #sr_widget.onDemand p, #stock_pro.onDemand p{font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.28;} .onDemand .live_stock{left:17px;padding:1px 3px 1px 5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:18px;top:9px} #sr_widget.onDemand .sr_desc{margin:0 auto 0;} #sr_widget.onDemand .live_stock p a{color: #fff;;} #sr_widget.onDemand .sr_desc{color: #024d99;margin-top:10px;} #sr_widget.onDemand .crypto .live_stock .lb-icon{8px 6px 5px 3px !important} #sr_widget.crypto.onDemand a.text{border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;padding-bottom:5px;display:block;width:100%} #sr_widget.onDemand .sr_desc .text p, #stock_pro.onDemand .sr_desc .text p{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;} Will the deployment of AI in various use cases lead to more consolidation in the fragmented technology landscape that is cybersecurity? Just yesterday I was talking to the employees about this. In 2009, there were hundreds of security vendors and the discussion was how it was going to consolidate. The consensus was that this is going to consolidate like crazy and there's going to be five major players because no one wants to deal with all these vendors. Fast forward now. I just went to the Black Hat conference in Las Vegas. It looks exactly the same. There are just as many vendors, except every booth said the same thing. They all said AI security and some variation of it. I really felt an enormous empathy for a customer who was walking around. .bgBig{border-bottom:0;padding:20px 0 0 0;} .bgBig a.bglink{font-family:Faustina;font-size:20px;font-style:normal;font-weight:600;line-height:normal;border-bottom:0;}

Will AI simplify? I don't think so. This is a new technology that is moving faster than anything we have seen. Enterprises are adopting it rapidly. Security departments want to naturally say, hold on, let us get our hands around it. But the business value is too big for enterprises to slow down [on AI adoption] right now.
